description: Source code implementing various filters for listing objects in a Git repository, including filters for blobs, trees, object types, size limits, sparse checkouts, and combining multiple filters.

methods.name: filter_blobs_none
methods.description: Filter that includes all tags, commits, and trees, but omits blobs, optionally collecting omitted OIDs.

methods.name: filter_blobs_none__init
methods.description: Initializes the filter to use filter_blobs_none function.

methods.name: filter_trees_depth
methods.description: Filters objects to omit trees and blobs beyond a certain depth, tracking seen trees at different depths.

methods.name: filter_trees_update_omits
methods.description: Updates the omits set by inserting or removing an object OID based on inclusion.

methods.name: filter_blobs_limit
methods.description: Filters blobs based on size limit, omitting large blobs and optionally collecting omitted OIDs.

methods.name: filter_sparse
methods.description: Filters objects based on sparse checkout patterns, including or omitting blobs accordingly.

methods.name: filter_sparse_free
methods.description: Frees resources used by sparse filter.

methods.name: filter_sparse_oid__init
methods.description: Initializes sparse checkout filter from a blob OID or pattern list.

methods.name: filter_object_type
methods.description: Filters objects by specified object type (commit, tag, tree, blob).

methods.name: process_subfilter
methods.description: Processes a subfilter for the combine filter, managing seen and skipping states.

methods.name: filter_combine
methods.description: Combines multiple subfilters, showing objects only if all subfilters agree.

methods.name: filter_combine__free
methods.description: Frees resources used by the combine filter.

methods.name: filter_combine__finalize_omits
methods.description: Finalizes the union of omitted OIDs from subfilters.

methods.name: filter_combine__init
methods.description: Initializes a combined filter from multiple subfilters.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__init
methods.description: Creates a filter object based on specified options and filter choice.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__filter_object
methods.description: Applies the filter to a given object, deciding whether to show, skip, or mark as seen.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a filter.
